body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG introduced four plasma HDTV series including eight new models, six with Full HD 1080p display capability at the 2008 International CES. The 50-inch model of the flagship ‘PG60 series’ was awarded as the CES 2008 “Best of Innovations” video display honoree for its intuitive style, advanced display technologies and consumer benefits.

LG also unveiled its stylish 2008 LCD HDTV line – eight series, 24 models, 17 Full HD1080p display capability – with screen sizes ranging from 19- to 52-inches. The line features multiple design and technological innovations, including a stunningly designed 1.7-inch thin LCD, a unique wireless HDTV and a model with LED backlighting technology. The 1.7-inch thin LGX Super slim has a slim silhouette, red-colored back and round aperture with LED light while LG70, LG71 and LG75, include a unique design, red color accenting and a high gloss black finish. A new invisible speaker system adds the beauty of the LCD HDTV line.

Other advanced features are TruMotion 120Hz technology, wireless connectivity and Image Science Foundation custom calibration certification (ISFccc) which provides more options for consumers seeking premium LCD HDTV performance.
